hero.title: Autonomy Elevated
hero.description: Developing robust Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), custom flight control firmware, and intelligent aerial edge-computing payloads for high-endurance operations.

capabilities.title: Avionics & Flight Controls
capabilities.description: Configuring, tuning, and compiling custom ArduPilot or PX4 autopilot firmware for custom multirotor and fixed-wing UAV configurations.

capabilities.title: Aerial Edge AI & Vision
capabilities.description: Integrating onboard companion computers (Jetson series) for real-time target tracking, optical flow localization, and obstacle avoidance.

capabilities.title: Structural & Propulsion Tuning
capabilities.description: Optimizing thrust-to-weight ratios, carbon fiber chassis layout, and electronic speed controller (ESC) telemetry for high-efficiency flight profiles.

projects.title: Aerial Robotics Minefield Navigation Drone
projects.description: This project presents a ROS2-enabled autonomous aerial drone system designed for minefield navigation and detection using multi-sensor fusion.

projects.title: Autonomous Under-Water Drone High Mobility Exploration System
projects.description: This project involved the design and development of an autonomous underwater drone capable of operating in challenging aquatic environments with high manoeuvrability and structural stability.
